env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd cap

logos context 'example.com/bigcap#Big'
stdout 'F001'
stdout 'F099'
! stdout 'F100'
! stdout 'F150'
cp stdout $WORK/out.txt
grep -count=99 'F[0-9][0-9][0-9] int' $WORK/out.txt
! grep '^}' $WORK/out.txt

cd ..

-- cap/go.mod --
module example.com/bigcap

go 1.27

-- cap/main.lgo --
